cohort.revisions: frozen recorded40hexSHAs; not freshly resolved; do not replace failures

existingMethod.visibility: pub(crate) trait/client/file acquisition, confirmed by assigned github.rs owner; usable from one first-party in-crate ignored test/helper, not external crate
existingMethod.cliLimits: No --write/--synthesize. This captures current HEAD, not the cohort revision; --source-url is not a revision selector. seed --targets-file --limit100 --dry-run is no-write but also current-head and loses individual cost fields.
doNotUse: run_autonomous_index_batch.py: invokes --write and retained telemetry/regression outputs

minimalExperimentPath: ONE experiment-only in-crate helper invokes the existing explicit-SHA file-acquisition API for all100 frozen identities on baseline and revised sources; no production CLI/API extension or separate acquisition platform.

Use the same frozen language-map input for both variants. Cohort currently records primary language, not a demonstrated full languages map. If no retained map exists, capture the metadata/language prelude once under separate authorization, retain it, charge its requests/bytes/time, and replay identical inputs to both variants. Do not silently fetch current HEAD files or invent language-byte counts.

Keep client source selection/file acquisition unchanged apart from the reviewed successful-tree reuse delta. No importer/writeback/model/native project execution is needed for the acquisition-only comparison.

Use a prebuilt baseline/revised helper with exact source/binary hashes; exclude compilation from acquisition timings and retain it separately. Retain each requested identity, exactSHA, variant, status/error/budget-stop, fetched paths/content hashes and metrics; all100 stay in denominator.

Record paired per-repository results and full100 totals; retained failures/timeouts/403/404/absent files are outcomes, not reasons to replace cohort rows. An incomplete bounded attempt leaves the full100 empirical goal pending.

existingMeasurements.http: Crawl report NetworkUsage supplies received-response count and advertised Content-Length u64 according to owning contract; it is not full attempted HTTP/body/wire accounting. Code-owner confirms missing header becomes0 and transport failures are not counted as received responses.
existingMeasurements.wall: cmd_crawl wallTimeMs covers crawl internals; totalWallTimeMs covers command logic up to report construction, before JSON serialization/CLI teardown. Python commandWallTimeMs includes process startup/cargo when used. Use outer prebuilt-helper elapsed for batch totals and per-phase clocks for attribution.
existingMeasurements.cpu: process_resources RUSAGE_CHILDREN delta is suitable for serialized child measurements, not overlapping children in one orchestrator. Sampler ps subprocess costs can also enter those global child deltas; disclose instrumentation overhead.
existingMeasurements.memory: best-effort process-group RSS via ps every0.2s, can miss short peaks and returns null when unavailable; not exact peak/cgroup maximum. Existing helper has no hard deadline/output cap.
existingMeasurements.planning: refresh-plan reports aggregate totalWallTimeMs but no network/CPU/RSS. Autonomous unchanged rows zero only downstream crawl cost after live head/planning work; unit report excludes that phase.
existingMeasurements.coldWarm: No existing controlled cold/warm measurement protocol. Fresh HttpGitHubClient per repository invocation resets an invocation-local tree cache; reused successful tree within that invocation is the delta. A second whole process is not a warmed version of that map. OS/DNS/TLS/CDN state remains external/uncontrolled unless explicitly observed.

minimumMeasurementGap: Durable per-attempt HTTP ledger covering successes, non-successes, transport failures and retries; distinguish attempted requests from received responses, and actual decoded body bytes from Content-Length/unknown wire bytes. Account partial/capped bodies and failures before abort.

Expose acquisition-phase wall/accounting and flush totals on errors, plus metadata/planning prelude totals. Current crawl success-only network report and zero-skip aggregates cannot reconstruct missing costs.
Enforce declared request/body/time/output stop budgets around the existing API and retain partial100 ledger; do not treat posthoc totals as enforced bounds.

proposedBoundsBeforeAnyLiveAuthorization.scope: all100 identities, baseline+revised =200 planned repository acquisitions, no replacement; one measured pair each initially, no automatic warm-repeat campaign
proposedBoundsBeforeAnyLiveAuthorization.quotaRule: actual total also <=observed available readonly GitHub quota minus500 reserved requests; quota check itself charged. If below required work, stop and retain incomplete, no credential/rate-limit escalation.
proposedBoundsBeforeAnyLiveAuthorization.existingHttpBehavior: owner reports30s request/10s connect and3rate-limit retries; all retries count; no new retry/backoff policy; outer absolute deadline must stop the experiment even if existing retry behavior would wait longer.
proposedBoundsBeforeAnyLiveAuthorization.interpretation: These are prospective finite stop ceilings, not a10–15request target or a claim all100 fit. Root decides authorization/bounds before live acquisition; reaching a cap retains noncompletion and leaves full100 comparison required.

deltaInterpretation: Successful per-invocation tree reuse may remove duplicate successful tree HTTP fetches only.404 is not cached. Leaf/body fetches, failures, metadata/language work and parsing remain; owned unit cases cannot establish10–15requests/repository or full100 costs.
limits: Read-only source/metadata assessment; no github.rs implementation inspection duplicated. Its API visibility/counter/timeout facts are attributed to the assigned owner confirmation.
No live requests, source acquisition, model/provider calls, records/writeback, upstream native workloads or code changes.
